rationale: Plan implements early-warning model per task objective. Uses 25% test split as specified. Defines high-cost as paid_amount > 95th percentile computed on training data only to avoid leakage. Feature set includes clinical and administrative attributes available at claim intake (claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, flags, primary_icd10_cm, drg_present, billed_amount, allowed_amount) while excluding post-adjudication fields (paid_amount, member_oop, cob_amount) and target-derived fields (high_cost_flag). Trains logistic regression and random forest as required. Preprocessor fitted on training data only for proper validation. Includes caveats addressing model limitations and severe class imbalance (5% positive rate).
